roomsIntro.title: The accommodations at Atlantis 12
roomsIntro.lead: a sanctuary of calm and beauty
roomsIntro.text: Nestled among the trees and within a restored Berber sheepfold, our guesthouse in Essaouira offers unique suites and rooms, combining modern comfort with authenticity. In these bright spaces, featuring fireplaces, terraces or private patios, stone and wood blend with a bohemian and artistic décor. Whether you choose an intimate small suite or a spacious superior room, each accommodation is designed to offer calm, elegance, and conviviality. The typical stone walls of Essaouira bring warmth and character, while the windows and glass doors open onto the garden, the pool, or the thuya forest, inviting relaxation and contemplation. A refined setting, inspired by art and nature, for an unforgettable stay in Essaouira.

aboutPage.seoDesc: The story of Atlantis 12, a guesthouse near Essaouira—haven of calm, creativity and hospitality.
paragraphs: This is how Atlantis 12 was born — a guesthouse nestled in the Essaouira countryside, envisioned as a refuge for travelers seeking peace, beauty, and meaning.

Tucked inside a lovingly restored former Berber sheepfold, Atlantis 12 unfolds across one hectare of preserved nature, between thuya forests, Atlantic light, birdsong, and soothing silence. A charming retreat, far from the hustle and bustle, yet just minutes from the medina and the sea.
Asmae has infused the place with her gift for hospitality, her attention to detail, and her desire to offer a heartfelt welcome, rooted in Moroccan tradition and the joy of sharing.

Lahcen, for his part, has shaped the space with his artistic soul and sensibility: textures, materials, volumes, and carefully chosen objects converse to create a unique and inspiring atmosphere — ideal for both creative flow and restful retreat.
Atlantis 12 is far more than a place to stay — it’s a haven, a restorative experience, a pause.
A space to reconnect with yourself, with nature, with your creativity.
A living, evolving place — open to encounters, emotions, and silence.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.intro: We understand plans can change. Here are our cancellation terms designed to balance your flexibility and our organization.

rows.right: Any cancellation at least 7 days before arrival entitles you to a full refund of the deposit with no fees.

For cancellations between 6 and 2 days before arrival, 50% of the deposit will be retained as compensation. For stays of 4 nights or more, this percentage may be adjusted depending on the period or the room reserved.
For cancellations less than 1 day before arrival, or in case of no-show, the deposit is retained in full.
We do our best to offer a rescheduling solution subject to availability if requested at least 7 days in advance. No fees apply for changes made within a reasonable time.

table.title: La Table d’Hôtes
table.p1: Our table d’hôtes lies at the heart of the Atlantis experience: a moment of sharing, generosity, and culinary discovery. Inspired by Moroccan, Andalusian, Berber and Jewish traditions, our cuisine celebrates fresh, seasonal produce.
table.p2: Meals are prepared from our garden, the local market, or the day’s catch. We don’t freeze: if there’s no catch, there’s no fish on the menu. This respect for the product guarantees the authenticity and quality of every plate.
table.p3: Around a large convivial table—or in a more intimate setting on request—guests gather to enjoy couscous, tagines, grilled fish, colorful salads and homemade pastries. Each dinner is unique, shaped by the season and what’s available.
table.p4: For that reason, meals are served by reservation only: to offer you fresh, sincere and generous cuisine, true to the spirit of Atlantis.

maison.title: The Guest House
maison.subtitle: The spirit of Essaouira — silence, beauty and warmth
maison.p1: Born from the shared dream of Asmae and Lahcen, Atlantis 12 is a guest house in Essaouira, Morocco, nestled between wild nature and the ocean. More than accommodation, it is a sensitive and artistic experience where every detail tells a story.
maison.p2: In this haven inspired by Berber traditions, traditional architecture blends with the shifting light of Essaouira. Artworks created or exhibited on site converse with the simple, warm gestures of hospitality.
maison.p3: At Atlantis 12, silence soothes, beauty inspires, and every stay becomes a moment of sharing, creativity, or contemplation.
maison.p4: Whether you’re seeking an authentic stay, a retreat, or an artistic place by the sea, our guest house opens its doors to you with heart.
maison.quote:
Between the wind and the stone,
there is
a silence that inspires.
maison.footer: Here, everything is shared: the light, the bread, and the peace of the place.

maisonDArt.title: The Art House
maisonDArt.subtitle: If hospitality is the first face of Atlantis 12, art is its beating heart.
maisonDArt.p1: Beyond the rooms and gardens, Atlantis also stands as an Art House where creativity is lived, shared and celebrated every day.
maisonDArt.p2: Paintings, sculptures, unique objects and music converse with the stone and the light of Essaouira, giving the place an inspiring and soothing atmosphere.
maisonDArt.p3: The atelier regularly hosts resident artists, open to experimentation and creative encounters.
maisonDArt.p4: Exhibitions, improvised concerts and jazz evenings bring Atlantis to life, turning each stay into a cultural and sensory experience.
maisonDArt.tagline: Thus, Atlantis 12 blends two vocations: a refuge of beauty and calm, and a living space of artistic creation.

activites.title: Experiences
activites.subtitle: An invitation to unique and meaningful moments.
activites.p1: During the day, you can rejuvenate by the pool, wander through the garden, surrender to a massage beneath the argan trees, dream away on the rooftop facing the immensity of the forest, or explore your creativity during an intuitive painting workshop.
activites.p2: The more adventurous set out to discover Essaouira and its surroundings: sunset horseback rides, camel treks to the wild beaches, surfing or kitesurfing on the best spots of the Atlantic coast, quad excursions through the countryside and dunes, or leisurely strolls through the medina and its Moroccan craft boutiques.
activites.p3: At nightfall, the atmosphere shifts: Lahcen sometimes picks up his guitar to improvise a musical moment with friends; on other evenings, the star-filled sky puts on a magical show from the terrace; and when the desire to go out calls, we happily share our best local addresses to enjoy Essaouira’s vibrant evenings.
activites.p4: Atlantis 12 is the ideal starting point to blend relaxation, creativity and discovery. A guesthouse in Essaouira designed to experience life differently — at the rhythm of your desires.
